{{Short description|German-born Israeli molecular biologist and professor (born 1926)}}

[[File:Uriel Bachrach - 26-dec-2021 in Yemin Moshe.jpg|thumb|Bachrach in 2021]]
'''Uriel Bachrach''' ({{Langx|he|אוריאל בכרך}}; born 9 September 1926) is a German-born Israeli molecular biologist and professor at the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]]. He is best known for his work on the physiology and function of naturally occurring [[polyamines]].<ref name="semanticscholar.org">{{Cite web|url=https://www.semanticscholar.org/author/U.-Bachrach/3616612|title=U. Bachrach &#124; Semantic Scholar|website=www.semanticscholar.org}}</ref>  He was also a founding member of [[Hemed]], the Israeli Science Corps, which developed munitions and weapons for the [[State of Israel]] prior to its founding as a state in 1948.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://medicine.ekmd.huji.ac.il/en/research/urielb/Pages/default.aspx|title=Professor Uriel Bachrach|website=medicine.ekmd.huji.ac.il}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Uriel Bachrach was born in [[Heilbronn]], [[Germany]], in 1926 and immigrated to [[Palestine (region)|Palestine]] in 1933 at the age of six. In 1945 he began studying chemistry at the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]].<ref name="auto">The Power of Knowledge - HEMED: The Israeli Science Corps, English edition, Dekel Publishing House, 2016</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=חדשות בן עזר - 192|url=https://library.osu.edu/projects/hebrew-lexicon/hbe/hbe00192.php|access-date=2020-08-25|website=library.osu.edu}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Uriel_Bachrach |title=Profile: Uriel Bachrach |website=[[ResearchGate]]}}</ref>

In 1947, [[David Ben-Gurion]] directed a group of twenty physics and chemistry scientists, including Uriel Bachrach, to form HEMED, the Israeli Science Corps, under the direction of [[Ephraim Katzir]]. HEMED was the nascent defense industry for the State of Israel.<ref name="auto"/><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.haaretz.co.il/magazine/letters/1.8928279|title=גם לי היה תפקיד סודי בהקמת מדינת ישראל|newspaper=הארץ}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.hayadan.org.il/israeli-science-army-1406096|title=בכוח הידע: סיפורו המופלא של חיל המדע הישראלי|date=13 June 2009|website=הידען}}</ref>

In 1949, Bachrach earned a master's degree in [[biochemistry]], and in 1950 he earned a master's degree in [[microbiology]].  He was awarded a [[Ph.D.]], degree in 1953.  Bachrach joined the faculty of medicine at the Hebrew University, and in 1971 was appointed a full professor and chairman of the department of [[molecular biology]]. He has been a visiting professor at various American and European universities.

In 2009, Bachrach published a [[Hebrew language|Hebrew-language]] book about the founding of HEMED.<ref>{{cite web | title=בגובה העיניים עם פרופ' אוריאל בכרך| website=makorrishon.co.il | url=https://www.makorrishon.co.il/nrg/online/54/ART2/237/807.html | language=he | access-date=9 November 2023}}</ref> In 2016, he published an [[English language|English-language]] version of his book about the creation of the Israeli Science Corps, ''The Power of Knowledge - HEMED: The Israeli Science Corps''.<ref name="auto"/><ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20200720131302/http://www.ybz.org.il/_Uploads/dbsAttachedFiles/Ari_Barell_LR.pdf Ari Barell]</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.ynet.co.il/articles/0,7340,L-5233824,00.html|title=ההיסטוריה של חיל המדע|date=20 April 2018|website=ynet|last1=נבו |first1=איתי |last2=דוידסון |first2=מכון }}</ref>

== Honors and awards ==
In 1995, Bachrach was awarded an honorary doctorate by the [[University of Bologna]] in [[Italy]].<ref name="auto"/>

In 2009, Bachrach received a special prize from the State of Israel given by President [[Shimon Peres]] for his contributions to Israel for his work in HEMED.

In 2010, Bachrach received a special award from the Mayor of [[Rome]] for significant contributions to [[cancer research]].  He was one of the organizers of the 11th International Conference on [[Polyamine]], [[Cancer]] and Other Diseases, in [[Tivoli, Lazio]], [[Italy]].

== Research ==
Bachrach has conducted extensive research in the field of polyamines and studied various aspects of their development.<ref name="LoC9">{{Cite web|url=http://www.huji.ac.il/cgi-bin/dovrut/dovrut_search_eng.pl?mesge129111831232688760|title=The Hebrew University of Jerusalem - Division of Marketing & Communication|website=www.huji.ac.il}}</ref> Bachrach continues to lecture in various forums about this unique chapter in Israel’s history.  He has also published numerous articles on molecular biology, [[chemistry]], and cancer research.<ref name="LoC5">{{Cite web|url=https://medicine.ekmd.huji.ac.il/en/research/urielb/Pages/publications.aspx|title=Professor Uriel Bachrach|website=medicine.ekmd.huji.ac.il}}</ref><ref name="semanticscholar.org"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.outlookconferences.com/olcmbc-2019/speakers.php|title=Speaker, Cell Science Conferences 2019, Oral Presentation, Keynote Presentation, Young Research Forum, Symposium. Research work presentation on cell science congress-2019, Share Research knowledge in prestigious summit of cell science meeting at Duabi-2019.Cell Science conference in Asia.|website=www.outlookconferences.com}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Bachrach is married to [[Zohara Yaniv]]-Bachrach, an ethnobotanist, researcher and lecturer in the field of medicinal plants. They live in the [[Yemin Moshe]] neighborhood of Jerusalem.
